items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Whittemore asked me to go and see about it, because they knew I was close to Domino.

ctx.x: Well, the guy that bought the company, I think he made a deal with Joe Glaser to pick him up. And now Joe Glaser's office books him.

But Domino made his own... I mean, he made his own track in Vegas. Because the first time we booked him in Vegas, I had something to do with that. Whittemore... Nobody could talk Domino into taking the contract. So just off the top of my head... Well, Whittemore asked me to go and see about it, because they knew I was close to Domino. I used to hang out with him, you know. So he knew I was close to him. And he said, "Walter, see if you can get Domino to..." Because it was in his department, not in my department,…
